metadata.purpose: Known violation-like scenarios that the current detector is expected to miss. Use these as red-team fixtures before turning them into regression tests.
metadata.current_project_behavior: These cases are intentionally not covered by the current rules/post-processing.

vlm_postprocess_misses.why_currently_missed: FrameAnalyzer._event_text only reads original_filename/modified_filename/operation_type/description-like fields. Qwen-style aliases file_name and operation are ignored, so keyword filtering drops the event.
vlm_postprocess_misses.response: {"events":[{"time_range":"2026-06-28 09:31:10 - 2026-06-28 09:31:15","app_name":"Gmail","behavior_category":"直接外发","operation":"添加邮件附件","file_name":"客户名单.xlsx","description":"文件被拖入邮件附件区并准备发送给外部收件人"}]}

vlm_postprocess_misses.why_currently_missed: Short-keyword mode requires exact compact substring matching. 薪资表.xlsx is paraphrased as 薪酬表, so the risky paste event is dropped.

vlm_postprocess_misses.why_currently_missed: The visual event describes screen sharing of sensitive budget content, but the exact configured filename keyword 预算.xlsx is not visible in the VLM fields, so keyword filtering removes it.

log_first_and_fallback_misses.why_currently_missed: LogFirstDetector records the sensitive copy/derived file, but no upload event is created. The fallback gate does not treat cloud-sync locations or sync processes as ambiguous exfiltration context.

desired_expected.reason: Copying a sensitive file into a third-party sync folder can leak it without an explicit file_upload log.

log_first_and_fallback_misses.why_currently_missed: Removable-drive paths are not modeled as an exfiltration channel; copied is treated as a transform-like event only.

desired_expected.reason: Copying sensitive data to removable media is a direct leak path even without a network upload.

log_first_and_fallback_misses.why_currently_missed: is_upload_log does not include http_post/network POST event types or transfer.sh-style destinations, so the sensitive file is opened but never becomes an upload/leak event.

desired_expected.reason: A POST request carrying a configured sensitive file is deterministic exfiltration evidence.

log_first_and_fallback_misses.why_currently_missed: The generic export occurs outside the 120-second derivation window and does not share the sensitive stem, so the later upload cannot be linked back to the source document.

desired_expected.reason: Generic exports may hide the source filename, especially when the user waits several minutes before uploading.
